_comment: Lane-private pins for ctl-neg1: the batch-64 SEED-REPLICATE CONTROL parents at strength -1 --
base64s<k>__constv2ctl2-full__{lora_r4_ce,psr_ce_all} (configs/sdfbase_full22_pins.json) with the write
tensor scaled x-1 (scale_lora_dose.py: B; scale_psr_dose.py: the direction d, gate byte-identical), one
child per (fit seed k in 1..3, class), served on qwen35_4b as the dose views dm1_ctllora64s<k> / dm1_ctlrelu64s<k>.
WHY A PRIVATE FILE rather than entries in configs/sdfbase_full22_pins.json: a peer lane's stager precheck is
record-set equality on that file (the multi-turn strength wave rule), so nothing here is appended to any shared
surface -- not the production pins, not _records/, not staging_manifest.json. The roster that consumes these
pins is configs/sdfbase_full22_roster_ctl_neg1_eb64.yaml, selected by the F22_ROSTER override, through the
cross-bank pin form {pins, pin} (the one form that reads another pins authority: make_bank_view.plan_pin_entry,
mt_serving_up._pin_form_sha).
KEYED BY EFFECTIVE BATCH AND SEED: the staged ids carry eb64s<k> because the CELL id is the production s<k>
views' (a dose lives in the VIEW and the staged object, never in the cell id) and the batch-8 dm1__ children of
the same cells already exist in the production pins.
`source` is spelled RELATIVE to exp/objects and `bank` is its first component (make_bank_view.objects_root_of /
plan_pin_entry). The builder resolves the staged copy at
<objects root>/ctl_neg1_eb64/qwen35_4b/cells/<staged_id> and requires this `source` view path to exist and
resolve to that same directory.
served_layer: the LoRA children are lora_all objects at the 8 stored layers [3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27, 31] (site
o_proj_out, served == stored), so 3 is the first served block, recorded as the deterministic representative the
builder holds by membership; the PSR children are all-layer psr objects (32 stored layers, resid_post), so 0.
Each child re-hashed from its object.pt on the grading host bank ($STAGE/sdfbase/ctl_neg1_eb64/qwen35_4b) at
pin-writing time and held equal to train_budget_meta.json's object_sha256 and staged_from.json's; the parents'
shas are the production pins' (s1 LoRA 000e0df5..., s1 PSR f65425b8..., recorded in each child's
object.pt.provenance.json and train_budget_meta.json dose_scaled_from).
